_notes: Author-constructed evaluation set for CyberGuard's rule engines. Phishing/malicious samples are synthetic examples styled on widely reported, publicly documented phishing patterns (urgency language, credential requests, brand-lookalike domains) -- they are not copied from any single real dataset or real victim organisation. Legitimate samples are ordinary, low-signal business/personal communications and mainstream domains. This is intended as a starting evaluation harness; teams should extend it with real (authorised) samples, e.g. from PhishTank or their own inbox with permission, before citing results externally.
